blocks.text: MAT:000–022 DETAILED REVIEW STATUS — NOT CANONICAL

The nine-root first-principles peer-review packet is complete. It scores four genuinely different directions per address, specifies boundaries and runtime behavior, audits all cross-family collisions, and stress-tests 75 Matter concepts. Validation passed 22 checks and 2,592 deterministic generation assertions. No authoritative atom meaning or generated form changed.
Recommended semantic grid pending user decision:
MAT:000 — persistent material substrate — The enduring matter that constitutes a focal entity’s physical body.
MAT:001 — active material substrate — A focal entity’s material substrate in a presently energized physical state.
MAT:002 — dormant material substrate — A focal entity’s material substrate persisting without presently expressed physical activity.
MAT:010 — distinct material object — A materially bounded body treated as a distinct external object.
MAT:011 — active material object — A distinct external material object in a presently energized physical state.
MAT:012 — dormant material object — A distinct external material object persisting without presently expressed physical activity.
MAT:020 — stable material aggregate — A collection of material constituents treated as one persistent physical aggregate.
MAT:021 — active material aggregate — A material aggregate whose constituents are presently in collective energetic interaction.
MAT:022 — dormant material aggregate — A material aggregate persisting without presently expressed collective physical activity.

Design boundary: MAT:0xx classifies material entities and conditions by scope—focal substrate, distinct external object, or aggregate—and lexical expression—stable, physically active, or dormant. Integrity, tool purpose, access, circulation, storage, transformation, movement, life, cognition, data activity, and social activity are not silently absorbed. Material processes remain for MAT:1xx; capacities and relationships remain for MAT:2xx.

Current semantic authority remains 45 canonical roots and 279 provisional roots. MOV:200–222 and MAT:000–022 are reviewed but await user decisions: 18 reviewed-pending roots. The remaining semantic workload is 261 unreviewed roots in 29 nine-root chunks.
